$comment: R497 forge share. target (0.9): the share of countable heavy runs that must run on Forge. windowMinutes (60): the trailing window the share is measured over. alertAfterMinutes (60): the share must also have been below target that long ago before forge-share-below-target alerts. expectedLocalReasons: named fallback reasons expected to run locally; they are counted separately and excluded from the share (needs-git is listed ahead of that reason existing).
